query:
-- Governor races in May 19 states
SELECT 'Governor' as chamber, state_code, dem_candidate, rep_candidate, status, primary_winner, pct_reporting, notes
FROM governor_races
WHERE state_code IN ('GA','KY','OR','PA','WV','NE','ID')
ORDER BY state_code;
